description: 護理師（nurse）的建置配方：build_character.py 依這份檔案從頭產出角色。每個步驟的輸入輸出見 design/03-art-pipeline/CHARACTER_PIPELINE.md。
name: 護理師

design.prompt: Anime cel-shaded character art in the style of Studio Trigger's Cyberpunk Edgerunners: flat colors, bold clean black outlines, hard-edged two-tone shading, saturated neon accents. Full body, strict side view facing right, standing upright with the arms relaxed at the sides and empty hands, the far-side leg hidden behind the near leg. a transit station nurse in her thirties, about seven heads tall, tired but efficient: unkempt short black hair pinned up with a plain clip, dark circles under the eyes, a rumpled faded teal-grey scrub top and trousers with worn knees and a pen in the breast pocket, a plastic ID badge on a lanyard, a face mask pulled down under the chin, a small cyan lit tablet clipped at the hip, scuffed white clogs. Empty hands. Uneven rough hand-inked linework with varied line weight, gritty grime and fabric wrinkles, slightly asymmetrical, lived-in and worn, matte not glossy, not airbrushed, no idealized perfect face.
